ground_truth_rule: A dimension is labeled 'incorrect' when the injected error directly harms that dimension's quality. expected_pass is true only when every dimension in the case is labeled 'correct'. A dimension is 'detected' when the evaluator scores it below detect_threshold (0.9).
design_rule: Every case except A starts from a known-correct existing agent trace (source_trace) and applies exactly one documented mutation (mutation field), except case H which applies three. No random mutations are used.
